STATUS: COMPLETE
SEVERITY: S2 — matching the matrix row "a tier-1 or tier-2 service is degraded for many users." checkout-api is a tier-1 service (per lookup), and elevated latency plus sporadic 504s affecting roughly 30% of active users is degradation for many users. S1 does not apply: the service is operational and no transaction data or payments are lost, so neither the "tier-1 unavailable" nor the "money or data being lost" condition is met.

**Service:** checkout-api
**Owning team:** payments (on-call: payments-oncall@northwind.example)
**Runbook:** https://runbooks.internal.northwind/checkout-api

**Has this happened before?** Yes, similar incidents exist on record:
- **INC-2041** (S1, checkout-api, resolved 2026-07-14) — "Card authorisation timeouts": checkout hung on the payment step with shoppers seeing timeouts on charge requests; root cause was a payment-provider endpoint degradation. This is the closest match to the current symptom.
- **INC-2098** (S2, checkout-api, resolved 2026-08-02) — "Elevated 5xx on /v2/charge": intermittent 5xx/errors after a deploy caused by a connection-pool regression. Relevant given the gateway timeout symptoms.

Worth checking both prior root causes when triaging — a recent deploy (per INC-2098) or upstream provider degradation (per INC-2041) are the two patterns that have produced this symptom before.

Customer note:
**Checkout — service disruption update**

Some shoppers may notice checkout is slower than usual, with occasional timeouts when completing a purchase — this affects roughly 30% of active users. Checkout itself remains up and running, and no orders, payments, or transaction data have been lost. We're sorry for the inconvenience; engineers are actively investigating the cause. We'll share another update as soon as we know more.

incidents.symptoms: Card payments fail at authorisation; checkout hangs on the payment step; shoppers see timeouts on charge requests
incidents.root_cause: The payment provider degraded its authorisation endpoint during a certificate rotation, and gateway retries amplified the latency
incidents.resolution: Provider rolled back the certificate change; authorisation latency recovered within 40 minutes

incidents.symptoms: Intermittent payment failures; 5xx errors on the charge endpoint; error rate spiked right after a deploy
incidents.root_cause: A deploy shipped a connection-pool regression; the pool exhausted under peak load and requests were refused
incidents.resolution: Rolled back the deploy; pool sizing fixed in the follow-up release

incidents.symptoms: Customers not receiving email notifications; delivery queue growing; order confirmations delayed
incidents.root_cause: Upstream mail provider throttled the account after a template change raised message size
incidents.resolution: Template assets moved to CDN; queue drained; provider limits raised

incidents.resolution: Reindex job re-queued off-peak; lag drained to under a minute
